name: root-crate-git-split
body: The `git` module is organized as `src/git/state.rs`, `src/git/identity.rs`, `src/git/commit.rs`, and `src/git/time.rs` under `src/git/mod.rs`; the module FQN `rust.apg.git` anchors the submodules, and the test module is `rust.apg.git.tests`. `solution.component.scan-hygiene` and `solution.component.structural-claiming` are implemented-by `rust.apg.git.state.path_is_ignored`, and `solution.component.identity-layer` is implemented-by `rust.apg.git.identity.repo_rel`.
